resources.string: Shows recent Proton Mail messages captured from notifications
No new mail yet.\nNew Proton Mail notifications will appear here.

This app reads Proton Mail notifications and shows them in a home screen widget. It only listens to Proton Mail — nothing else — and nothing ever leaves your device.

1. Tap the button below and enable access for Proton Inbox Widget.
2. Long-press your home screen → Widgets → Proton Inbox Widget.
No log entries yet. Send yourself a test email, then tap Refresh.
